name: incus-core
description: The `sudo incus` invocation and the JSON read every incus-touching module shares — one place where the decision to reach the daemon as root lives, plus the transcript of `incus config set --help` two renderers are anchored to
instructions: The library `vm`, `vm-provision` and any other daemon-facing module import as `../incus-core`; it reaches the machine through `../host-exec`, which `zbc add` installs with it. `config-set-help.ts` and the `.txt` beside it are test support: `incus config set --help` captured verbatim from incus 6.0.0, so a module's rendered argv can be checked against the binary rather than against a literal a renderer's author wrote.
